cases.description: gov5's post-quantum type byte 0x05 on the type-2 payload: not in Profile 1.
Type byte 0x06 on the type-2 payload: not in Profile 1.
Type byte 0x50 (N42 Ed25519, O3) on the type-2 payload.
Type byte 0x51 (reserved) on the type-2 payload.
Type byte 0x5F (reserved) on the type-2 payload.
Type-2 transfer with gas = the 480M block gas limit.
Type-2 transfer with gas 2^32-1 (EIP-8037 cap): above the 480M block gas limit, so gov5's includability check refuses it (OPEN, see README).

deferred execution: block 1 exceeds its gas limit at tx 0

notes: Each case is judged alone in block 1 on the standard genesis plus the funded test sender (key = keccak256("n42-profile1-vectors-sender")); the block header is given in 'block'.

Stages in order: decode (EIP-2718 bytes), typeRule (C1-C4: only 0x00, 0x01, 0x02, 0x04), includable (deferred-execution includability: gas, fee cap, intrinsic gas, initcode cap, EIP-7702 shape), execution. refusedAt names the first stage that refused; the error strings are gov5's and informative only.
Pool policy is a subset of these verdicts (C7): a gov5 Profile-1 pool refuses every case marked invalid.
